steps.what: Search the actual legal-library catalogue and scholarly indexes and choose readings suited to the assignment
inputs: actual assignment topic and student level
catalogue and scholarly-index source records
outputs: teacher-selected source records for the reading list

steps.what: Assemble the selected records into the required citation style and reading-list order
inputs: teacher-selected source records for the reading list
required bibliography style and assignment order
outputs: formatted bibliography draft with catalogue identifiers

steps.what: Resolve each citation to the actual source, check edition, relevance and student access, and finish the reading bibliography
inputs: formatted bibliography draft with catalogue identifiers
actual source texts and library access information

steps.what: Save the completed reading bibliography in the course workspace
inputs: complete checked specialist reading bibliography

tasks.design: Configure the native reference-manager export in {OTHER} to format actual selected catalogue records into {DOCS}. The teacher chooses and verifies every reading and its access before saving the finished bibliography in {LMS}; no model invents references.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual citation transcription and formatting can duplicate catalogue metadata.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reference exports can reuse source identifiers and style rules deterministically.
tasks.still_hard: A valid citation can still be unsuitable, outdated or inaccessible to the students.
tasks.human_edge: Choose specialist readings that serve the assignment's legal learning goals.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: reference managers can format bibliographies from actual source records, with teacher verification of relevance and access.

assumptions: Shares are provisional and unmeasured; citation formatting must actually be manual today for any gain.

OTHER means legal-library catalogues, scholarly indexes and the native reference manager. Existing publishers/librarians supply title, author, edition, identifier and access metadata; s1 selects actual records.
Missing or inconsistent fields are corrected from the source in retained checking, not guessed. Existing automatic bibliography export removes the corresponding saving.
Gross provisional saving 16 minus 1 hour of style/export upkeep gives 15 net. Saving remains fully retained; publishing the list is not proposed.
unknowns: Existing bibliography automation and metadata completeness
research_questions: How much real bibliography effort is still citation assembly after source selection and verification?

already_counted.description: Review assembly and verify every citation, edition and access route

incremental.description: Maintain citation style and test changed export fields

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 15%; only applies where native reference export is not already used.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read the actual funding call, eligibility requirements, assessment criteria and application format
inputs: actual funding call and application instructions

steps.what: Develop the research question, contribution, methods, work plan and intended outcomes
inputs: teacher-checked proposal requirements
actual research knowledge and available project resources
outputs: teacher's substantive research design and project commitments

steps.what: Prepare and check the proposed budget and resource justification using actual permitted rates and project needs
inputs: teacher's substantive research design and project commitments
actual institutional rates and funding rules
outputs: checked proposal budget and resource justification

steps.what: Write and revise the proposal narrative and complete its factual, methodological and call-compliance checks
inputs: teacher-checked proposal requirements
teacher's substantive research design and project commitments
checked proposal budget and resource justification
actual supporting publications supplied by the teacher
outputs: complete checked research grant proposal version

loop.purpose: Assist narrative drafting within the teacher's actual research design
loop.input: call requirements, teacher's research design, checked budget and supplied supporting publications
loop.output: draft narrative with source/brief references and explicit unsupported sections
loop.check: teacher verifies novelty claims, methods, citations, commitments and consistency with the budget
loop.stop: unsupported claim, missing commitment or conflict with the call requires manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: fixed application fields cannot express the substantive research argument

steps.what: Save the completed checked proposal in the existing project document workspace
inputs: complete checked research grant proposal version

tasks.design: Use existing proposal templates in {DOCS} first, then a bounded drafting aid for the narrative supplied by the teacher's research design and actual supporting publications. The budget stays in {SPREADSHEET}; the teacher checks the complete proposal before saving it, with no automatic external submission.
tasks.previous_blocker: Expressing an actual research plan in a funder's narrative structure requires repeated drafting.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-bounded drafting can propose wording without inventing the research or budget.
tasks.still_hard: Novelty, feasibility, methods and institutional commitments require accountable judgment.
tasks.human_edge: Formulate the research contribution and make defensible project commitments.

ambition.what: No extra applications or higher award rate claimed.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-6 for approved processing of unpublished research and funding terms

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: bounded narrative assistance can help express an existing research plan, but cannot establish novelty or make project commitments.

assumptions: Shares are provisional work scenarios, not measured grant-writing baselines.
OTHER means the funding-call portal, read only. The teacher produces research-design content in s2 and checked budget in s3; actual institutional rates are existing inputs.
No new structured research database is assumed. Source packaging beyond ordinary drafting is incremental below.
Gross provisional saving 9.8 minus 2 hours of source packaging and drafting-rule upkeep gives 7.8 net. Existing templates and formula calculations are credited to today's workflow, not new saving.
Saving is negligible and retained. Institutional grant approval and submission follow writing and are not automated or claimed here.
unknowns: Permitted processing and current narrative revision effort
research_questions: Does assistance reduce total narrative work after substantive checking on actual past proposals?

already_counted.description: Correct and check the substantive proposal narrative

incremental.description: Package permitted sources and maintain/test drafting instructions against call changes

approvals.approved_version: complete checked research grant proposal version

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 7.8%; substantive research and budget work remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Provide professional legal consulting to government or industry

steps.what: Read the client's actual facts and documents and research the relevant legal authorities
inputs: client's actual consultation facts and documents
authoritative legal sources for the matter
outputs: teacher-checked facts, legal sources and unresolved questions

steps.what: Discuss the actual issue with the client, clarify facts and explain the legal options and their limits
inputs: teacher-checked facts, legal sources and unresolved questions
client's actual questions and clarifications
outputs: actual consultation and clarified advice requirements

steps.what: Develop the legal analysis and write and check the actual written consulting advice for the client
inputs: teacher-checked facts, legal sources and unresolved questions
actual consultation and clarified advice requirements
existing institutional consulting-document format
outputs: complete checked client advice and intended recipient

steps.what: Send the completed checked advice to the intended external client
inputs: complete checked client advice and intended recipient
outputs: client receives the checked consulting advice

tasks.design: For an engagement that actually includes written advice, configure the existing consulting-document format in {DOCS} to reuse headings and the client's supplied matter identifiers. Research, analysis and client discussion stay with the teacher; the checked final advice and recipient are established before the separate {EMAIL} send.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated document formatting can accompany substantive consulting analysis.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document templates can reuse fixed matter fields without generating legal advice.
tasks.still_hard: Incomplete facts, conflicting authorities and client objectives require professional interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: Take responsibility for contextual legal reasoning and explain its limits.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-4 for client confidentiality and document access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native document templates can reduce fixed formatting in written consulting advice while legal analysis remains human.

assumptions: This is an unmeasured written-advice engagement scenario, not a claim that every consultation has a report. Pure oral advice has no s3 formatting saving.
OTHER means authorised legal-source research. The client supplies the actual matter identifiers and facts; s1/s2 examine and clarify them. Missing facts remain explicit.
Only fixed fields and layout change in s3; no semantic legal drafting or new report is introduced.
Gross provisional saving 3.9 minus 1 hour of template upkeep gives 2.9 net. Existing templates remove that gain; the final send is fully retained.
Changes after final checking invalidate the send gate; client instructions and institutional consulting permission still govern the engagement.
unknowns: Actual oral/written engagement mix and existing document templates
research_questions: Do real written engagements contain repeated formatting that native templates have not already removed?

already_counted.description: Develop, write and check the substantive consulting analysis

incremental.description: Maintain fixed document fields and consulting templates

approvals.approved_version: complete checked client advice and intended recipient

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 2.9%; only real written engagements with remaining formatting work qualify.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.ambitious_version: Spend less time on citation formatting and bounded drafting while retaining research originality, legal judgment and client responsibility.
